'''Scout One''' was a [[Void Jumper]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Marines]] who participated in the [[assault on the New Jedi Temple]]. The [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] verified the clearance of the Void Jumpers' approach while breaking through the corridors of the [[New Jedi Temple]]. The mission was led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] and [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]] [[Gef Olazon]] against [[Abeloth]], who was in the [[Jedi Temple's computer core]].
